SELECT
FROM job_communication_record jcr
LEFT JOIN resume r ON r.id = jcr.resume_id AND r.user_id = jcr.user_id
LEFT JOIN job_position jp ON jp.id = jcr.job_id
LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = jp.company_id
WHERE jcr.user_id = #{userId} AND jcr.is_deleted = 0 AND jp.is_deleted = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0
AND jcr.communication_status = #{query.status}
AND jcr.platform = #{query.platform}
AND ( jcr.hr_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR jcr.hr_reply LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR jcr.note LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.resume_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR jp.job_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY jcr.update_time DESC, jcr.id DESC
